entries.english:
Rents and tithe revenues of the Rosenberg rent office at Krumau, from both hereditary and pledged monastic estates.

Estates of Maidsstein. At the St George's term: LXXXXIIII ρβ, XVII gr., IIII den.; at the St Gall's term: LXXXXIX – XXXI – [amount illegible]. Total: CLXXXXIII – XLVII – III.

Estates of Krumau. At the St George's term: LVI – LVIII – V; at the St Gall's term: LXVII – VII – Vj. Total: CXXV – VI – III.

Estates of Krems. At the St George's term: XXIII – LII gr., V den.; at the St Gall's term: XXXII – XXVIII – III. Total: LVI – XX – Vj.

Estates of Masskowitz. At the St George's term: XVII – XXIII – VI; at the St Gall's term: XXII – XVII – VIj. Total: XXXIX – XLI – V. Total of the hereditary estates of the Krumau office for both terms and the full year, including pledged property: IIII c XIIII ρβ, LVII gr., III den. The monastic estates follow.

Estates of Sweraz. At the St George's term: XLIIII ρβ, XXXVIII gr., Vj den.; at the St Gall's term: LXIII – XXXIIj – [amount illegible]. Total: CIX – XI – II.

Judicial district of Hasslowitz. At the St George's term: XII – LII – IIII; at the St Gall's term: XXI – XXXIX – III. Total: XXXIX – XXXI – Vj. Total of the estates listed above: CLXIII ρβ, XLIII gr., I den.

Estates of Holy Crown. Judicial district of Boletitz: at the St George's term XXVIII ρβ, XXIII gr., V den.; at the St Gall's term CIII – XXXII – V. Judicial district of Pollen: at the St George's term XXXI – XLIIII – IIII; at the St Gall's term LXXXXIII – XLII – [amount illegible]. Judicial district of Plan: at the St George's term XVIII ρβ, XLI gr., V den.; at the St Gall's term XLV – LIII – III. Judicial district of Mokrau and Moldau: at the St George's term XII – XXXV – V; at the St Gall's term XVIII – III – IIII. Judicial district of Chvalšiny: at the St George's term XXIIII ρβ, XXXVIII gr., I den.; at the St Gall's term LXII – LVIII – VIj. Judicial district of Zvíkov: at the St George's term XV – XLVIIj – [amount illegible]; at the St Gall's term XXIX – XXVIII – V. Judicial district of Ktiš: at the St George's term XIX – XLV – V; at the St Gall's term XXXVII – IIII – VI. Judicial districts of Chroboly and Frantoly: at the St George's term XVI – XVI – V; at the St Gall's term XVII – VII – IIII. Judicial district of Štítiny: at the St George's term III ρβ, XXIIII gr., V den.; at the St Gall's term IIII – XXVI – [amount illegible]. Total at the St George's term: II c XLVI – XV – III. Total at the St Gall's term: VI c XLII – X – II. Total annual rent of Holy Crown estates: VIII c LXXXVIII ρβ, XXVj gr. Total of the monastic estates in the Krumau office: MXXXII ρβ, VIII gr., IIII den. Annual total for the entire office, including the hereditary estates of the Krumau lordship: XIIII c XLVII ρβ, VI gr.

Grain yields of the Krumau lordship: wheat LXXXXII t.; rye III c XXXIII; barley XL; oats II m XIII and one quartale; poppy seed XLIX – IIj. Total: II m V c XXVII – IIj.

Tithes on the estates of Holy Crown: wheat VI c LXXX t.; rye XVIII c XX; barley XV c LXXVIII; oats IIII m III c; peas LIII and one quartale. Total: VIII m IIII c XXXI t. and one quartale.
